description: Source code for a Windows-specific dump reader class (DumpReaderWin) used in breakpad crash dump analysis, including methods for checking CDB availability, extracting process IDs, and retrieving stack traces.

classes.name: DumpReaderWin
classes.description: A class for reading and processing crash dumps on Windows, extending DumpReader with Windows-specific functionality.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DumpReaderWin with host and build directory, and setting CDB availability to None.

methods.name: check_is_functional
methods.description: Checks if the CDB debugger is available for symbolizing minidumps.

methods.name: _file_extension
methods.description: Returns the file extension used for dump files, 'txt'.

methods.name: _get_pid_from_dump
methods.description: Extracts the process ID from a dump file by reading and parsing its contents.

methods.name: _get_stack_from_dump
methods.description: Retrieves the stack trace from a dump file using cdb, if available.

methods.name: _find_depot_tools_path
methods.description: Attempts to locate depot_tools directory in the system PATH.

methods.name: _check_cdb_available
methods.description: Determines whether the cdb debugger is installed and accessible, setting internal state accordingly.
